facts.fact: Biometric Update says the NIMC Act 2026 replaces the NIMC Act 2007, expands NIMC's duties and makes it the Root Certification Authority for the national PKI and digital public infrastructure; no enactment date is given, so the published date is used.

note: Standing only; the document does not state that the Act sets up a biometric register or unique number, or any dated rule made under it.
